# NeuroCode

> Self-hosted hierarchical knowledge graph for Python codebases (Tree-sitter → Neo4j → ReactFlow).

NeuroCode parses Python projects into an explorable package/module/class/function graph. Designed for engineers onboarding to large local codebases. MIT licensed. Early alpha (0.1.x).
